cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)

project(render_ir VERSION 0.1.0)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

set(AUDIO_DSP_TOOLS_DIR
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/NeuralAmpModelerPlugin/AudioDSPTools")

set(DSP_SOURCES
    "${AUDIO_DSP_TOOLS_DIR}/dsp/dsp.cpp"
    "${AUDIO_DSP_TOOLS_DIR}/dsp/ImpulseResponse.cpp"
    "${AUDIO_DSP_TOOLS_DIR}/dsp/wav.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/render_ir.cpp")

include_directories("${AUDIO_DSP_TOOLS_DIR}")
include_directories("${AUDIO_DSP_TOOLS_DIR}/Dependencies/eigen")
include_directories("${AUDIO_DSP_TOOLS_DIR}/Dependencies/nlohmann")

target_compile_definitions(render_ir
    PRIVATE "FIXTURES_DIR=\"${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}\"")

if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
    target_link_libraries(render_ir PRIVATE stdc++fs)
endif()

if(NOT MSVC)
    target_compile_options(render_ir PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter -O2)
endif()
